name: Maxwell’s distribution of molecular velocities
description: Maxwell gave a statistical distribution of molecular velocities in a gas, advancing kinetic theory.

impact.note: A statistical law added to an existing kinetic theory of gases, used by physicists across countries; statistical mechanics developed from it.

date.basis: Year of the dated publication, or a broad historian-estimated composition interval; no first discovery claimed.

events.statement: Maxwell published the kinetic-theory distribution in 1860.

evidence.supports: Discusses the 1860 distribution and its antecedents and later revision.

contributions.resource: Developed and published the statistical velocity distribution.

evidence.supports: Discusses the 1860 distribution and its antecedents and later revision.

earliest_record.rationale: Dated witness within the inspected evidence; not a global-priority claim.

caveats: His model built on earlier kinetic and probability work, including Clausius; the 1867 account revised the argument and assumptions. This is a historical theoretical model, not a direct measurement of individual molecules.
